reason: 要旨は「Activation steering can change behaviour without establishing that the effect is specific to the intended concept. We introduce SteerCheck, a preregistered attribution audit that matches off-target KL and separates mean, protected-tail, polarity, transfer, and semantic claims. Exact replay of 960 Qwen3-14B interventions reveals」を扱い、対象契約のLLM inference/serving効率・推論時圧縮への寄与を示していない。
title: SteerCheck: Attribution Specificity and Alignment Leakage in Activation-Steering Audits
